translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Dhiyo adhiya nyime gitimo timbe mabeyo,
to bangʼe notimni ngʼwono.
Chiw achiwa mwanduni ni ji mangʼeny,
nikech ikia gima kiny notimreni.
Ka polo odudo,
to koth chue e piny.
Kata ka yien olwar yo milambo kata yo nyandwat,
kama olwarieno, kanyo ema iyude.
Ngʼama osiko mana ka ngʼiyo kor polo ok nokom;
to ngʼama rito mana ni mondo koth ochwe, ok noke.
Mana kaka ok inyal ngʼeyo kama yamo luwo,
kata ngʼeyo kaka nyathi chakore ei min,
omiyo ok inyal ngʼeyo gima
Nyasaye ma jachwech gik moko duto timo.
Chwo kodhi mari gokinyi,
to godhiambo kik iwe lweti bed maonge tich,
nimar ok ingʼeyo
kata gibiro twi,
giduto maber.
Ler ber
kendo omiyo wangʼ neno maber.
To kuom higni mangʼeny ma dhano nyalo dak,
we mondo obed mamor kuom hignigo duto.
Makmana wiye kik wil gi ndalo mag mudho
nikech kosetho to ndalo mag mudho nobed mangʼeny moloyo.
Gimoro amora mabiro bangʼe onge tiende.
Bed mamor, in wuowi matin,
ka pod in rawera kendo tim gik moko duto ma chunyi dwaro.
Tim gik moko duto ma chunyi gombo
kendo wangʼi nyalo neno,
to kata kamano nyaka ingʼe ni
Nyasaye nongʼadni bura kuom gik moko duto mitimo.
Omiyo koro, gol gombo duto oko e chunyi
kendo kik iwe gombo mag ringruok thagi,
nikech bedo rawera maratego bende onge tiende.
